title: Joplin, Missouri · May 22, 2011
summary: Read warning chronology, damage research and remembrance without treating county segments or differing fatality counts as interchangeable.

records.basis: NCEI event narrative explicitly describes the Joplin tornado through Jasper County; source title uses the starting locality Central City.
NCEI event narrative explicitly identifies the continuation of the Joplin tornado into Newton County. This alias does not merge records or ratings.

observations.title: Tornado watch
observations.locator: Printed page 2, Table 1 chronology. Warning map on PDF page 9, printed page 3.
observations.account: SPC issues a tornado watch for southwest Missouri through 9 p.m. CDT.
observations.limits: A watch describes a threat area. It does not predict a future street-level track.
